The metric is a monotonic sum in bytes, so rate(...[$__rate_interval]) is the right construct. The result is bytes per second, which should be confirmed against the Datadog docker.io.read_bytes semantics (cumulative bytes vs per-second rate) before the unit is accepted as the same.

The operation="read" filter and avg by (container_image_name) match the Datadog intent (read bytes, averaged by image). The dataset label container_image_name is observed, so the grouping label is valid.
Per-device series (device_major, device_minor) are summed or averaged across by the avg, which is a series-grain caveat worth noting in the notes, but it is not the blocking issue.
The $scope template variable has no prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct. The outcome translated is correct because no Datadog function is used.
